video.desc:
各论各的 标题的他指男主他爸
Twenty-year-old rebellious rich heir Leo disguises himself as a stranger to hook up with Adrian, his father’s 41-year-old restrained best friend who secretly controls underground forces, as revenge for his dad’s neglect. After learning their bond, Leo intensifies his seduction to sting his father with this forbidden affair. Gradually, the young man falls hard—he claims he only seeks retaliation yet craves genuine attention from Adrian. Adrian sees right through Leo’s childish ploys, trying to push him away out of caution while unable to hold back tender protection. Trapped in power imbalance, transactional tension and social taboos, the two lonely wounded souls entangle dangerously, finding solace and redemption only in each other amid their secret risky romance.
二十岁的叛逆富家继承人 Leo，为了报复父亲的冷落，伪装成陌生人，与父亲四十一岁的挚友 Adrian 发生了一夜情——这个人表面克制沉稳，暗地里却掌控着地下势力。
得知两人的关系后，Leo 变本加厉地勾引 Adrian，想用这段禁忌之恋狠狠刺痛父亲。可渐渐地，这个年轻人越陷越深——他嘴上说只是为了报复，心里却渴望着 Adrian 真正的关注。
Adrian 一眼看穿了 Leo 幼稚的把戏，出于谨慎一再想推开他，却又忍不住温柔地护着他。困在权力的不对等、交易式的张力与世俗禁忌之间，两个孤独而受伤的灵魂危险地纠缠在一起，在这段隐秘而冒险的恋情里，只能从彼此身上找到慰藉与救赎。
